gloss: to put on makeup; to apply cosmetics

definitions.gloss: to put on makeup; to apply cosmetics
definitions.explanation: To apply cosmetic products to one's face or body to enhance appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{化粧|けしょう}する。
examples.english: I put on makeup every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{化粧|けしょう}しなきゃ。
examples.english: I need to put on makeup before going out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薄|うす}く→薄い：00764_usui⟧{化粧|けしょう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{綺麗|きれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Even though she's only wearing light makeup, she looks very beautiful.

notes:
Refers specifically to the act of applying cosmetics, particularly facial makeup. In everyday speech, the abbreviated form ⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧ alone or the expression ⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is also very common, especially among younger speakers.

The noun ⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧ appears in many compounds related to cosmetics and grooming.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to remove makeup
- ⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧{直|なお}し: makeup touch-up
- ⟦{薄化粧|うすげしょう}→薄化粧：16437_usugeshou⟧: light makeup
- {厚化粧|あつげしょう}: heavy makeup
- ⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧: cosmetics
- ⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧: toner; skin lotion
- ⟦{化粧|けしょう}ポーチ→化粧ポーチ：24260_keshoupoochi⟧: makeup pouch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do makeup — loanword equivalent, common in casual and fashion contexts
- ⟦{身支度|みじたく}→身支度：07910_mijitaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get ready; to groom oneself — broader term that includes dressing and hair, not just makeup
- ⟦{装|よそお}う→装う：09152_yosoou⟧: to dress up; to adorn oneself — literary, covers overall appearance rather than just cosmetics
